# Traction
> Traction (formerly Traction IT) is a Toronto-based GTM engineering consultancy that runs lead generation, enrichment, signal-based outreach, and retention for mid-market dealers, distributors, and resellers with a sales team.

Traction helps middlemen find more of the customers they already like working with and earn the most from. After a discovery call, the company turns the customers a client names into a profile, finds lookalike accounts with the evidence behind each one, writes outreach in the client's voice, starts conversations through the selected channels, and builds renewal and expansion triggers after the first win. The system runs in the client's own CRM and inboxes, so their team keeps it.

Traction serves dealers, distributors, and resellers in the US and Canada that sit between a manufacturer and the end buyer and already run a sales team. It is not a mass-email service, a generic lead database, or a long brand-campaign agency.

Core sales-engine components:

- Data: Build new account and contact lists, or clean, enrich, verify, and score existing data.
- Signals: Find timely reasons to contact an account, including new locations, manufacturer lines carried, hiring, dated events, and other public shifts.
- Infrastructure: Set up and manage dedicated domains, inboxes, warmup, deliverability, and compliant WhatsApp business numbers.
- Outreach: Write and send messages based on the signal, in the client's voice, through email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, or a coordinated blend.
- Qualification: Score opportunities and produce a shortlist with the fit, signal, and suggested opener.
- Retention: Track renewal and expansion signals so first customers can become repeat customers.

Engagements can target booked calls, market or account intelligence, enriched data, newly generated data, or pure outreach. Clients can choose fully managed delivery, review and approval before sending, or a collaborative copilot model. Pricing follows the selected outcomes, channels, involvement level, and infrastructure. A short pilot can prove the engine before a longer commitment.

Traction also develops PowerSell, an AI sales enablement product for sales teams inside HubSpot and Salesforce. PowerSell uses a sequence of agents to research a prospect, identify pain points, match the seller's products to those needs, and draft personalized outreach for review. Access currently rolls out from a waitlist in small batches.

The usual next step is to book a 15 minute discovery call or configure an engine. Traction replies within one business day with a proposed build plan, timeline, and price. Contact: contact@traction.it.com.

## Company

- Name: Traction. Former name: Traction IT. The LinkedIn page and this site use the current name; older coverage and the legal pages use the former one. Both refer to the same company.
- Founder: Kaan Un, Toronto. Personal site: https://kaanent.com/. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/kaan-un
- LinkedIn company page: https://www.linkedin.com/company/traction-it-gtm
- Headquarters: Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Clients in the US and Canada.
- Press: "GTM Engineering: How AI Is Creating a New High-Paying Career in Tech", Techloy, 2026-09-23, https://www.techloy.com/gtm-engineer-salary-career/
